question.text: Three identical coils $C_{1}, C_{2}$ and $C_{3}$ are closely placed such that they share a common axis. $C_{2}$ is exactly midway. $C_{1}$ carries current $I$ in anti-clockwise direction while $C_{3}$ carries current $I$ in clockwise direction. An induced current flows through $C_{2}$ will be in clockwise direction when

options.text: $C_{1}$ moves away from $C_{2}$ and $C_{3}$ moves towards $C_{2}$
$C_{1}$ and $C_{3}$ move with equal speeds away from $C_{2}$
$C_{1}$ moves towards $C_{2}$ and $C_{3}$ moves away from $C_{2}$
$C_{1}$ and $C_{3}$ move with equal speeds towards $C_{2}$
